display_long_description:
It’s one of those days. You leave your keys inside, get soaked by a passing car, spill coffee on your laptop and watch someone else get the promotion. Your holiday is cancelled, your new car won’t start and, just as you get your baby to sleep, the neighbours launch a disco. Naturally.

**Just one of those days when you say: “I’m having a bad day!”**

Well, make the most of it. Things can only get better. Or considerably more broken.
[media]

Welcome to **I’m Having A Bad Day**, a cartoon-style VR destruction game where bad moods meet very breakable objects. Pick a room, grab a tool and turn an ordinary day into an extraordinary mess. No need to keep your cool. Nobody’s judging.

# NOT EVERY PROBLEM NEEDS A SOLUTION. SOME NEED A HAMMER

Explore colourful locations, from office and gym to supermarket, museum and bar. Choose an axe, hammer, umbrella or frying pan. Each has its own weight, size and destruction style. Experiment with speed and force. It’s surprisingly satisfying.

[media]

# YOUR DAY IS BAD. YOUR AIM DOESN'T HAVE TO BE

Take on challenges that test your speed, precision and creativity. Smash specific objects, follow an order, use the right tool or beat the clock. Complete challenges to unlock new rooms and tools.

Enjoy physics-driven destruction, haptic feedback, an energetic soundtrack and commentary on your performance. Play seated or standing in a 6DoF room-scale area.

Pick a room. Grab a tool. Break everything.

**Make a mess. And have a good day!**
